condition_description: Streetlight is out on a public street
routing_note: Municipal streetlights are a municipality responsibility. If the wire is visibly sparking or dangerous, escalate to BC-002.

condition_description: Exposed/sparking electrical wire — immediate public danger
hitl_reason: Immediate physical danger. CD dispatched for scene safety; EDL for grid isolation.
routing_note: Always co-route EDL + Civil Defense. Do not treat as routine outage.

condition_description: Electricity fault in Zahle city or Zahle district (Bekaa)
hitl_reason: EDZ concession area — EDL is NOT responsible. HITL to confirm Zahle district vs rest of Bekaa.
routing_note: GPS must confirm Zahle district. If unconfirmed, HITL.

condition_description: Electricity issue appears to be from a private generator (moualid), not grid
hitl_reason: Private generator faults are not EDL responsibility. Cannot auto-route.
routing_note: HITL always for electricity — agent must confirm EDL grid vs private generator before routing.

condition_description: Road damage reported but road class (local vs national) is unclear
hitl_reason: Local road → MUN; classified/national road → MPWT. Cannot distinguish without GPS or road name confirmation.
routing_note: If road is clearly inside a residential area/neighborhood → MUN. If it is a named national highway or bridge → MPWT.

condition_description: Pothole or damage on a local/internal/residential street
routing_note: Local roads and sidewalks are a municipal responsibility.

condition_description: Damage on a classified national road or bridge
routing_note: Classified/national roads and bridges belong to MPWT. Active CDR project sites → CDR.

condition_description: Waste is hazardous, chemical, medical, or burning
hitl_reason: Hazardous materials require MOE. Civil Defense if fire/immediate danger. MUN as co-entity for local clearing.
routing_note: Routine waste → MUN only. Add CD if fire present.

condition_description: Active flooding causing immediate danger or requiring rescue
routing_note: CD dispatched first for emergency rescue. MUN follows for drainage repair. CDR for national drainage infrastructure failure.

condition_description: Fire incident that may involve arson or criminal activity
hitl_reason: Criminal dimension requires ISF. CD handles fire suppression. Cannot auto-route ISF.
routing_note: Always HITL when ISF is co-entity. Human confirms criminal relevance before ISF is notified.

condition_description: Water complaint with no confirmed governorate
hitl_reason: Water authority is determined by governorate (BMLWE/NLWE/SLWE/BWE). Cannot route without location.
routing_note: Resolve governorate via GPS or citizen input before routing to water establishment.

condition_description: Internet outage — unclear if fixed-line (OGERO) or mobile data (Alfa/Touch)
hitl_reason: OGERO handles fixed-line only. Mobile data issues → Alfa/Touch (not a public entity in CedarFix scope). HITL to confirm.
routing_note: If citizen says 'DSL', 'ADSL', 'landline', 'fiber' → OGERO. If 'mobile data', '4G', 'cellular' → out of scope.
